## Workspace 图谱

- 在主窗口顶栏打开「图谱」，选择 Workspace 并构建索引。从仓库概览下钻到 TypeScript 模块依赖和受支持的跨仓事件链，点击关系即可查看两端的源码与行号。
- 在图谱页构建或更新索引，也可在普通聊天中使用 `/build-graph` 和 `/update-graph`。更新期间仍可查询已发布且通过核验的关系。
- 使用 `/ask --graph 问题` 为本次调查启用图谱线索。最终引用可以打开原始源码。图谱页还可以查看改动影响，以及核对 Wiki 文档中的来源引用。

## Workspace graph

- Open Graph from the main toolbar, choose a Workspace and build its index. Drill down from repositories to TypeScript module dependencies and supported cross-repository event flows. Select a relationship to inspect source lines at both ends.
- Build or refresh the index from Graph, or run `/build-graph` and `/update-graph` in a regular chat. Previously published relationships remain available during an update when their sources can still be verified.
- Use `/ask --graph <question>` to include graph lookup in an investigation and open the source behind its citations. Graph also lets you explore change impact and check the source references in a Wiki document.
